correctness.rationale: Geometric inversion of I-s(P-I) gives exact positive resolvent coefficients; differentiating R produces C²=I+4sR′ and proves that all off-diagonal signs equal the sign of F_n at the nearest neighbor. F_n is decreasing with a unique root for n≥4. The high-step involution limit excludes all odd k at n≥3, and the negative first-order expansion for C^(2m) excludes all fixed even k at n≥4. Exact independent rational Gaussian elimination verified 4496 assertions; infinite quantifiers rest on proof.

value.rationale: A Markov numerical propagator is only physically admissible when it maps nonnegative masses to nonnegative masses. The theorem identifies a natural exact dimensional exception where grouping two individually nonpositive steps repairs positivity without step restriction, and determines exactly why and where it stops working in larger directed cycles. The decreasing sharp H_n cutoff and all-powers parity classification supply a meaningful structural algorithm-design boundary beyond routine algebra.
